title: Langflow OSS through 1.12.8 has authentication bypass and unauthenticated code execution
summary: IBM reports authentication bypass and unauthenticated code execution, including an MCP tool-enumeration path. The same upgrade also addresses authenticated agentic command execution and credential disclosure. All four Langflow flaws are addressed by Langflow OSS 1.13.0.

severity.rationale: Unauthenticated remote code execution reaches the agent workflow server. No account or further user interaction is required in the published CVSS vector.

exposure: Exposed deployments allow attacker access to Langflow, including its MCP surface. Do not assume the authentication control prevents access.

remediation.details: Back up the database, secret key and uploaded files. Prepare automatic-login accounts for password sign-in, then upgrade the package or Docker deployment to 1.13.0.
remediation.risk: Medium. Authentication changes and persistent deployment data require upgrade preparation.

verification: Confirm the installed version or revision and exercise the affected workflow with trusted inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
Added the two other Langflow CVEs covered by the IBM upgrade, their individual scores and their authentication conditions.
